##### Project general facts

LIV Oceanside by LIV stands as a masterpiece of waterfront living on Dubai Islands, where architectural beauty meets coastal serenity. The project features a distinguished collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as 2, 3, and 4-bedroom duplexes and 4-bedroom penthouses, all with uninterrupted marina, sea, and skyline views. Designed with elegance and precision, every residence reflects the LIV signature - where sophisticated design and natural light create a sense of harmony and luxury at the water’s edge.

A sanctuary of refined living, LIV Oceanside embodies the essence of exclusivity and tranquility. Its flowing glass facades and wave-like contours mirror the gentle rhythm of the marina, while expansive terraces frame breathtaking sunsets. Each home is a perfect blend of space, light, and coastal grace, offering residents a truly elevated lifestyle defined by calm sophistication and panoramic beauty.

The development redefines luxury with a curated collection of world-class amenities that cater to wellness, leisure, and social connection. Residents enjoy access to a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the sea, a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studios, saunas, and steam rooms, as well as a cinema room, podcast and conference spaces, a games area, and elegant residents’ lounges. Outdoor zen gardens, family and kids’ pools, and wellness suites including massage, red-light, and hyperbaric therapy rooms complete a lifestyle where relaxation and vitality meet.

Each residence at LIV Oceanside is distinguished by a luxury finish in every detail, creating an atmosphere of timeless sophistication. Miele appliances, natural stone, and timber flooring are featured throughout, complemented by bespoke cabinetry, quartz surfaces, and European fixtures by Axor and Villeroy & Boch. From the grand entertainer kitchens to spa-inspired bathrooms and walk-in wardrobes, every space radiates elegance, comfort, and impeccable craftsmanship, redefining the standards of contemporary coastal living.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters.

The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities.

Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.
